fees.notes: Official UIS international fee for Diploma Sains Komputer (Diploma in Computer Science) (programme code ms39), last published on study.uis.edu.my (capture 20240805034809): RM24,508 total, an all-inclusive package covering registration, facilities & welfare, tuition & assessment, accommodation (Dormitory D, full-time only) and graduation. UIS's current programme page (https://study.uis.edu.my/ms39, accessed 2026-09-18) says tuition fee information will be updated soon, so this is the latest officially published international figure. fees.per_year = total / official duration. Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20240805034809/https://study.uis.edu.my/ms39.
